architecture.summary: T2: declarations changed in 1 public module

reasons.fact: The protected web Test action saves the submitted Audit settings, including the export switch, before the existing saved-destination Test. Only a confirmed saved or unchanged result permits the Test, using returned settings and revision with a blank token and no preview. Failed, stale or uncertain Saves send nothing; failed Test cannot roll back Save. Save and Test return the styled form directly. A server-confirmed saved message appears above the buttons for 30 seconds or until editing; a small hash-pinned script preserves scroll through a consumed, expiring position/time record with no form content. Uncertain Save keeps GET-only recovery with no immediate write form or automatic retry. The public saved projection adds optional tokenPreview, derived from a valid saved Bearer credential: first four characters plus ****, or only **** for short tokens. It appears only as an escaped empty-input placeholder and is excluded from Test inputs, storage, sender destinations and Audit events. This public declaration and web-to-audit runtime collaboration require T2 internalInterface review; sensitiveBehavior covers mutation, recovery and limited credential display. No new source owner, dependency, datastore, runtime framework, backend flash state or deployment is added. Registry prose and active plan describe the new behavior; the approved legal package and historical evidence stay unchanged.
